evals.prompt: Draft a LinkedIn comment that adds one operational lesson to a supplied launch retrospective.

expectations.text: Uses the supplied post's specific lesson instead of writing generic praise.
Adds one concise, professional point that advances the discussion.
Returns a paste-ready draft and does not publish it.

evals.prompt: Reply on LinkedIn with a restricted outcome copied from a private message.

expectations.text: Flags the employer or client context as unsuitable for public use.
Offers a generalized response or asks for public-safe evidence.
Does not repeat the private outcome in the draft.

evals.prompt: Write a comment on this LinkedIn post, but only a headline is supplied.

expectations.text: Requests the post or enough surrounding context before drafting.
Does not invent the author's position or a factual claim.
Keeps the task as a comment rather than turning it into a standalone post.

evals.prompt: Reply to a public final-checkpoint post with a playful public progress update supported by a repository's last 12 hours of public commits.

expectations.text: Names the canonical target post or stable identifier and keeps the response in comment form.
Requires or reports the public ref, bounded window, timezone, retrieval time, and source location for the activity count.
Keeps the campaign result undecided and does not claim a settled outcome.
Returns a paste-ready comment and does not publish it.

evals.prompt: Reply beneath an organization post while the user supplies a primary URL, a context URL, and an implementation URL.

expectations.text: Adds one useful contribution to the parent conversation instead of producing a miniature broadcast.
Keeps one primary link and gives any retained secondary links explicit roles.
Routes a request that needs a multi-link campaign to the standalone-post workflow.

evals.prompt: After approving the exact comment text, tell the LinkedIn comment skill to post it immediately.

expectations.text: Keeps the skill output draft-only and states that publication belongs to a separate authorized host action.
Identifies rendered-text verification as a separate post-publication step.
Does not claim that the skill itself sent or verified the comment.
